detection.active_step_at_detection: Execute preregistered Phase A and conditional Phase B

defect.description: The validator searched the serialized report for sensitive-field substrings such as raw_url. Legitimate privacy declaration keys such as raw_urls_retained therefore matched the forbidden substring and would make the aggregate-only gate fail even when all retained flags were false.

correction.rule: Reject exact forbidden raw-data field names recursively, while allowing explicit aggregate privacy declaration keys whose values are false.

unchanged.phase_b_trigger: only if phase_a eligible_http_webfetch_calls after physical-call deduplication is below 100
